parsed.notes_to_self: T15 t450: generic notice posted (Orange may engage anyone 1 full turn after delivery, earliest t500). All neutral. Rider sent to (450,568) ~203m to burn ~t469-475 and force a Q at t475: AT t475 PULL RIDER IN (e.g. 555,590 = 99m). Army holds ~(595,545), safe to ~t565. GPT trade closed: gave 6 Thracian swords @(460,670). Told Blue+White: contact t500 not t475 (else 1 full turn after first Q); me S face (10 Cretans ~675,612), Blue W, White N. Promised both: no strike on them while Green stands, then 1 full turn public notice before any hostility. Ring: t475 198, t500 177, t525 155, t550 133, t575 112, t600 90. Don't arrive first; hero behind lines. Never ally. After Green, steer Blue and White into each other.
parsed.explanation: The no-first-strike pact runs out at t450, so Orange posts the generic notice it promised Blue and White: it may engage anyone one full turn after delivery, t500 at the earliest. The army stays at its declared stop south of Green's camp while Orange privately confirms the three-sided west/north/south timing and honestly pays off its intel trade with Green. The scout rider deliberately steps a few metres beyond the shrinking ring to take a few seconds of fire, which blocks the quiet fast-forward so the notices land at t475 and the t500 window holds.
